story.titleZh: Jamie驾驶FW47完成TPC测试，成2015年后首位驾驶威廉姆斯F1赛车的女性
story.summaryZh: Jamie在波尔蒂芒驾驶FW47参加TPC测试，成为自2015年Susie Wolff以来首位驾驶威廉姆斯F1赛车的女性。

story.originalTitle: Milestone moment 💙 Jamie jumped in the FW47 for a TPC test in Portimão, becoming the first woman to drive a Williams F1 car since Susie Wolff in 2...
story.summaryEn:
Milestone moment 💙
Jamie jumped in the FW47 for a TPC test in Portimão, becoming the first woman to drive a Williams F1 car since Susie Wolff in 2015.
detailZh:
里程碑时刻 💙
Jamie在波尔蒂芒驾驶FW47参加TPC测试，成为自2015年Susie Wolff以来首位驾驶威廉姆斯F1赛车的女性。
detailEn:
Milestone moment 💙
Jamie jumped in the FW47 for a TPC test in Portimão, becoming the first woman to drive a Williams F1 car since Susie Wolff in 2015.
keyPointsZh: 上一次有女性驾驶威廉姆斯F1赛车是2015年的Susie Wolff
